day_line: An ocean on a Tiger day. Big and brave: good for bold starts and new ideas, easy to overreach.

lines.Yang Wood: A new angle clicks today. Sketch it on paper before you open the laptop.
lines.Yin Wood: Help flows your way today. Let a colleague show you the shortcut.
lines.Yang Fire: The tide pushes back today. Stay calm, finish one thing, and leave on time.
lines.Yin Fire: Your steady hand gets noticed today. Keep your word on the small stuff.
lines.Yang Earth: A bold chance rolls in today. Take it, but read the fine print first.
lines.Yin Earth: Sensible choices pay today. Compare two prices before you tap the card.
lines.Yang Metal: You're in a playful mood today. Make the meeting fun, then make it short.
lines.Yin Metal: Your sharp eye helps today. Point out the fix kindly, with a smile.
lines.Yang Water: Your crowd moves as one today. Plan something together after work.
lines.Yin Water: Someone moves faster today. Let them; your careful version lands better.
